question: Should OpenClaw core add a per-agent backup/restore/clone CLI that can copy or rewrite agent state, credentials, workspaces, and transcripts, and what should be included or excluded by default?
rationale: The implementation boundary changes how sensitive persisted state is exported, rewritten, and restored; automation cannot safely choose the credential, transcript, rollback, and archive-format policy.

options.title: Design guarded core feature
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a design-backed implementation that defines secret handling, session transcript policy, rollback, path safety, and compatibility with broader backup work.

options.title: Wait for broader backup restore
options.body: Defer per-agent clone semantics until the encrypted snapshot or whole-instance restore direction is accepted, then layer the agent selector onto that archive format.

options.title: Document manual workflow only
options.body: Reject first-party per-agent restore for now and document a manual, security-caveated export/import process instead.

recommendation.title: Design guarded core feature
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a design-backed implementation that defines secret handling, session transcript policy, rollback, path safety, and compatibility with broader backup work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup-area work and maintainer-side routing make this the best available owner for the product/security boundary decision.
